outcome.Summary: Implemented `TopK(r io.Reader, k int, stop []string) ([]WordCount, error)` in `words/words.go`. It streams input through a 256KB `bufio.Reader` (so no full-text buffering and no long-line limits), tokenizes maximal runs of Unicode letters/digits with a rune-level state machine that keeps apostrophes only when they sit between two letters (so `don't`, `o'clock` count; leading/trailing apostrophes and apostrophes after digits don't), lowercases words, filters case-insensitive stop words, then sorts by count descending with ties broken by word ascending (byte order) and returns the top k (all if fewer, empty non-nil slice for k<=0), propagating any read error. Added `words/words_test.go` covering basics, leading/trailing apostrophes, k=0/fewer-than-k ties, read-error propagation, Unicode/digits, a 200k-word single line, and case-insensitive stop words; `go build`, `go vet`, and `go test ./...` all pass.
